top_news.title: Large-Scale ChatBot Validation Through Customer Digital Twin Simulations
top_news.dek: Researchers propose using synthetic customer agents as digital twins to validate LLM-based chatbots at scale.
top_news.brief: The methodology uses high-fidelity synthetic customer agents (SCAs) grounded in real transactional data to simulate interactions. This approach aims to provide a cost-effective and scalable way to test chatbot performance and safety in regulated environments like banking.
top_news.image_alt: Diagram showing the flow from real data to synthetic customer agent digital twins

top_news.title: AI Search - Use AI Search with the Agents SDK, AI SDK, and LangChain
top_news.dek: Cloudflare AI Search now integrates directly with Vercel AI SDK, LangChain, and the Cloudflare Agents SDK.
top_news.brief: Developers can now implement grounded retrieval in agentic applications using native framework integrations rather than manual REST API calls. The update includes a new AI SDK package and a dedicated retriever for LangChain.
top_news.image_alt: Code snippet showing the integration of Cloudflare AI Search with LangChain

top_news.title: Moonshot AI Open-Sources MoonEP: A Perfectly Balanced Expert Parallelism Library for MoE Training
top_news.dek: Moonshot AI open-sourced MoonEP, a library designed to improve communication efficiency in distributed Mixture-of-Experts training.
top_news.brief: Released under an MIT license, MoonEP focuses on balancing expert parallelism for MoE workloads. It was launched alongside the Kimi K3 model and other infrastructure tools, including FlashKDA and AgentEnv, to support large-scale distributed training.

top_news.title: FCC bans new Chinese robots and power inverters to protect US AI buildout from foreign threats
top_news.dek: The FCC has banned imports of new Chinese humanoid robots and power inverters, citing national security and supply chain vulnerabilities.
top_news.brief: The FCC's new National Security Determination restricts imports of Chinese-made robotics and power infrastructure. The policy aims to mitigate risks associated with concentrated supply chains for critical components like actuators and sensors, which the government views as potential vectors for geopolitical disruption.
top_news.image_alt: FCC logo and robotic hardware components

top_news.title: Agent-Manager: A Tmux TUI for Running Claude Code, Codex and OpenCode
top_news.dek: Agent-Manager is a new Tmux-based TUI designed to orchestrate and monitor multiple AI coding agents in a single terminal environment.
top_news.brief: This tool provides a terminal-based interface for managing sessions for Claude Code, OpenCode, and other AI coding agents. It features live status tracking, a group tree view, pane previews, and resource monitoring, allowing developers to manage complex agent workflows directly within Tmux.
top_news.image_alt: Terminal UI showing multiple AI agent sessions in Tmux
